answer: Audits are recorded in haven, queued in echo, and copper publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 85 identities per epoch. A farm of 140 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2130 identities would post 1205 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
